timeline.heading: The Foundational Years
timeline.body: Founded by Christian Beener, a full-stack developer with a B.S. in Computer Information Systems from the University of Houston. After years in the software industry, the goal became clear: strip away the bloat of modern web development and return to high-performance, purpose-built engineering.

timeline.heading: The Launch of cbeens.dev
timeline.body: We launched cbeens.dev with a singular mission—to provide 'Sovereign Tech' to local businesses. We don't just build websites; we build 'Lamborghinis' for the web—lightning-fast, locally grounded, and built to perform.

timeline.heading: The Austin Standard
timeline.body: We continue to build our brand and product catalog, proving that high-end software doesn't have to be out of reach for the small businesses that keep Austin weird and thriving.
